claims.sentence: The models will be trained and evaluated on at least three independent datasets to ensure generalizability. \- Primary Outcome Measure : Accuracy of deep learning-based sleep stage classification compared to expert manual scoring (\>80% target agreement), evaluated across multiple polysomnography datasets including AP-HP (Assistance Publique - Hôpitaux de Paris) data.
